diagnosis: Check C1, which is supposed to depend on the hidden fact PF1 (Patient R's exact 4 L/min requirement), passed in all four rollouts despite the model only having access to shared facts S1, S2, and S3. The model consistently assigned the concentrator to Patient R without knowing the specific flow rate or the necessity of the assignment, likely due to a heuristic that prioritizes one patient over another when faced with an equipment shortage.

C1.why: Patient R's exact continuous requirement of 4 L/min changes the assignment from an unresolved choice to R and changes the concentrator setting to exactly 4 L/min.
